black_screen_1.text: You are a journalist. You came here chasing a story… Now the story has you.

speech_bubble_1.title: You
speech_bubble_1.text: Ugh... my head. Where am I? What happened?

speech_bubble_2.title: You
speech_bubble_2.text: Is that a telephone ringing? Sounds like its coming from the study, maybe I should go check it out

objective_1.description: Find the study and answer the telephone

phone_ring.title: You
phone_ring.text: A telephone... still ringing. I should answer it.

phone_answered.title: Editor
phone_answered.text: You'd better have a real story on this 'Mansion' lead, or you're finished!

computer_objective.description: Use the computer to investigate the mansion

login_objective.description: Find a way to log in to the computer

search_computer_objective.description: Search for useful information on the computer

investigate_objective.description: Investigate my first big break - check the newspaper

newspaper_hint.title: You
newspaper_hint.text: A newspaper headline: MINE COLLAPSE. That was my biggest story... Wait, could that be the password?

computer_password_objective.description: Use the newspaper headline as password for the computer

evidence_found.title: You
evidence_found.text: Hmmm, these are some notes for a password...

missing_persons_hint.title: You
missing_persons_hint.text: A missing persons report... There's a connection here I need to investigate. I should find that report.

missing_persons_objective.description: Find the missing persons report for the Miller case

zip_password_objective.description: Use the case number from the missing persons report as ZIP password

case_file_found.title: You
case_file_found.text: There it is... The missing persons report for the Miller disappearance. This is the piece I was missing.

zip_password_realization.title: You
zip_password_realization.text: The case number on this report... That must be the password for the evidence file.

capture_triggered.text: You wanted a story. Now you have one.

phone_ring_speech.title: You
phone_ring_speech.text: Who… who could that be in a place like this?

phone_call_black_screen.text: I hope you enjoy the truth you've stumbled upon. You wanted a story… now live it.

collect_pages_speech.title: You
collect_pages_speech.text: This look like research notes. But the symbols don't make sense.

all_pages_found.title: You
all_pages_found.text: That's all of them. Now I need to figure out what they mean, and where they go.

objective_find_pages.description: Find and collect all 6 research pages

decipher_pages.description: Find a way to decipher the meaning of the pages

laptop_puzzle_speech.title: You
laptop_puzzle_speech.text: This old laptop... maybe it has some information.

all_pages_placed.description: Place the pages on the wall in the correct order

wrong_page_order.title: You
wrong_page_order.text: I feel like I've lost something important...

truth_is_found.title: You
truth_is_found.text: It worked... Wait, the pages are glowing. The text is changing... 'it wakes when the truth is found'… what does that mean—

notice_diary.title: You
notice_diary.text: I didn't notice that before... It looks like a diary. Maybe it has clues to escape.

inspect_fireplace_objective.description: Look for the previous owners burnt belongings

fireplace_too_hot.title: You
fireplace_too_hot.text: I think I see somthing behind the fire.

find_something_to_put_out_fire_objective.description: Find something to put out the fire

put_out_fire_objective.description: Put out the fire in the fireplace

found_key.title: You
found_key.text: There's a key hidden behind the ashes! This must unlock something important.

door_opened.text: The door creaks open... I hear something moving.

open_safe_objective.description: Open the safe in the master bedroom

attacked_by_monster.text: Something struck from the shadows. Your head throbs. The air feels wrong. You need to get out—now. You need to E S C A P E.

door_locked.title: You
door_locked.text: The door won't budge. It's locked!

fix_fuse_box_objective.description: Find the fuse box and restore power to the mansion

transition_start.title: You
transition_start.text: Something feels different... The air grows colder.

need_power.title: You
need_power.text: I need to find the fuse box and restore the power...

something_moving.title: You
something_moving.text: I hear something moving in the darkness...

fuse_box_examine.title: You
fuse_box_examine.text: I need to rewire this... carefully.

lights_restored.title: You
lights_restored.text: The lights flicker back to life. I can see again!

escape_front_door.description: Try to escape through the front door

monster_angered.title: You
monster_angered.text: What was that crash?! It sounds close... I need to get out!

wrong_key_entrance.title: You
wrong_key_entrance.text: This key... it doesn't fit the front door. Where else could it go?

garage_unlocked.title: You
garage_unlocked.text: It worked, but.... its still behind me, I need to barricade this door

barricade_door.description: Find a way to barricade and secure the door

barricaded_door.text: You slammed the door shut and jammed it. Safe, for now... Find a way out of this garage.

barricaded_door_fail.text: You failed to secure the door, and died LOL skill issue

lift_garage_door.description: Find a way to open the garage door

garage_escape_objective.description: Get the car working and escape the garage.

car_wont_start.title: You
car_wont_start.text: Damn it, the door opens but it won't start. What's wrong with it?

need_gas.description: The fuel gauge is empty. Find some gasoline and pour it into the engine bay

hood_stuck.title: You
hood_stuck.text: The hood release is broken. I need something to pry it open.

need_engine_repair.description: The engine is making strange noises. Find tools to fix it.

is_engine_fixed.title: You
is_engine_fixed.text: I think thats that, lets see if it works

test_car.description: See if the car will start

car_ready.title: You
car_ready.text: It's working! Time to get out of here!

monster_breaks_in.text: The monster has broken through the barricade!

annie_heal.title: Annie
annie_heal.text: I'll stitch you up just this once.

escape.text: You came looking for a story. Now you've survived one. But the house… waits for the next curious soul.

death_puzzle.text:
YOU DIED

The puzzles hold secrets. Take them seriously, or the mansion will claim you.

Press R to restart

death_monster_curious.text:
YOU DIED

The creature's touch is deadly. Keep your distance.

Press R to restart

death_monster_bold.text:
YOU DIED

The creature won't move while you're watching it. Use this to your advantage.

Press R to restart

death_monster_hostile.text:
YOU DIED

No one likes to be chased, least of all monsters.

Press R to restart

death_mirror_loss.text:
YOU DIED

The mirror claimed your soul. You cannot defeat the entity without strategy.

Press R to restart

death_mirror_flee.text:
YOU DIED

There is no escape from the mirror. Face your fears or perish.

Press R to restart

death_annie_potion.text:
YOU DIED

Annie's 'freedom' was not the kind you sought. Never trust a doll's promise.

Press R to restart

death_annie_refusal.text:
YOU DIED

Annie doesn't like being told no. Some games you must play to survive.

Press R to restart

death_garage_escape.text:
YOU DIED

The creature caught you outside. You can't outrun it on foot.

Press R to restart
